title_zh: 小核酸药物的化学修饰与性能调控
title_en: Chemical Modification and Property Modulation of Oligonucleotide Therapeutics
summary_zh: 围绕ASO、siRNA的化学修饰与改性，探究小核酸药物性能的调控规律和底层化学逻辑。
summary_en: We investigate how chemical modifications of ASOs and siRNAs regulate the properties of oligonucleotide therapeutics and the underlying chemical principles.
detail_zh: 化学修饰是增强核酸药物稳定性、底物亲和力和生物安全性的重要策略与底层技术，课题组围绕ASO、siRNA的化学修饰与改性，探究小核酸药物性能的调控规律和底层化学逻辑。
detail_en: Chemical modification is a key strategy and foundational technology for enhancing the stability, substrate affinity, and biosafety of nucleic acid therapeutics. Our group focuses on chemical modifications of antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) and small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) to uncover the principles governing the properties of oligonucleotide therapeutics and their underlying chemical basis.

title_zh: 小核酸药物仿生递送技术
summary_zh: 利用人工智能指导多肽设计与筛选，发展多肽/核酸液–液相分离微液滴仿生组装体系，实现靶标脏器的特异性递送与可控释放。
summary_en: We use AI-guided peptide design and screening to develop biomimetic peptide/nucleic acid microdroplets through liquid–liquid phase separation for organ-specific delivery and controlled release.
detail_zh: 利用人工智能指导多肽的设计与筛选，高效获得对核酸药物具有高亲和力与特异性的功能多肽，发展多肽/核酸液–液相分离微液滴仿生组装体系。通过引入靶向识别元件并调控微液滴的相变行为，实现对靶标脏器的特异性递送与可控释放。
detail_en: We use artificial intelligence to guide peptide design and screening, efficiently identifying functional peptides with high affinity and specificity for nucleic acid therapeutics. We develop biomimetic peptide/nucleic acid microdroplet assembly systems based on liquid–liquid phase separation. By incorporating targeting recognition elements and regulating the phase-transition behavior of these microdroplets, we achieve organ-specific delivery and controlled release.

title_zh: 核酸药物的转化与应用
title_en: Translation and Applications of Nucleic Acid Therapeutics
summary_zh: 探索多肽/核酸仿生递送系统的治疗效果与转化应用，推动核酸药物从实验室走向临床。
summary_en: We explore the therapeutic efficacy and translational applications of biomimetic peptide/nucleic acid delivery systems to advance nucleic acid therapeutics from the laboratory to the clinic.
detail_zh: 本课题组致力于核酸药物的临床转化，探索多肽/核酸仿生递送系统在脏器纤维化、遗传病、眼底疾病、代谢性疾病等领域的治疗效果与转化应用。通过液–液相分离微液滴体系实现靶标脏器的特异性递送与可控释放，提升核酸药物的生物利用度与治疗指数，推动其从实验室走向临床。
detail_en: Our group is committed to the clinical translation of nucleic acid therapeutics. We investigate the therapeutic efficacy and translational applications of biomimetic peptide/nucleic acid delivery systems for organ fibrosis, genetic disorders, ocular fundus diseases, metabolic diseases, and other conditions. Using microdroplet systems formed through liquid–liquid phase separation, we achieve organ-specific delivery and controlled release to improve the bioavailability and therapeutic index of nucleic acid therapeutics and advance them from the laboratory to the clinic.
